observed_selected_catalog_entry.title: Variable-length limbs, restoring division and owned capacity

environment.language: ISO C17 with exact uint16_t/uint32_t; published C17/C23 source access remains separate
environment.target: Hosted Linux; portable runtime-count core; Cortex-M4 object/link audits only
environment.dependencies: First-principles arithmetic. Allocator callbacks supply storage only; host Python integers are an independent verification dependency.

passages: 14.2.1 pp.592-594 radix length, zero and signed-magnitude representation
14.2.3 algorithm14.12 and note14.15 pp.595-596 inner-product bound B^2-1
14.2.5 algorithm14.20 and notes14.22-14.25 pp.598-599 quotient/remainder and normalized correction

limitations: Runtime limb count has no fixed implementation maximum; the finite driver workload is not its API extent.
No constant-time cryptography, physical target observation or independent learner assessment.

rubric.criterion: Derive canonical runtime-length radix representation, carry/borrow and exact multiplication accumulator bounds; implement transactional magnitude arithmetic and quotient/remainder.

levels.0: Breaks arithmetic, ownership or evidence contract.
levels.1: Runs one fixture without invariant or changed condition.
levels.2: Derive canonical runtime-length radix representation, carry/borrow and exact multiplication accumulator bounds; implement transactional magnitude arithmetic and quotient/remainder. Supply exact source-bound counterexamples and observations.
levels.3: Independently reconstructs both variants at least7days later.
